Cause: SQLite returns the PasswordResetToken.expires_at column as a naive datetime, dropping the UTC tzinfo that was stored. reset_password then compares that naive value with datetime.now(timezone.utc), which raises the TypeError.

Proposed fix (app/routers/auth.py only): add a small _as_utc helper that treats naive datetimes as UTC and converts aware ones to UTC, and use it in the expiry check. The check still short-circuits on a missing entry, so no None attribute access happens. I have not applied or tested this yet. Next step is to verify with run_tests on the failing test and then on tests/.
